question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay in external ClawHub plugins?
rationale: The missing capability is real, but the fix adds ranking semantics, config/default surface, persistent index behavior, and fallback policy that need maintainer product direction before repair automation should implement it.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add a `memory-lancedb`-owned hybrid mode with FTS index setup, explicit config/defaults, query-text propagation, vector fallback, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval to ClawHub
options.body: Keep official `memory-lancedb` vector-only and direct hybrid/reranker variants to external plugin packaging once maintainers accept that product split.

options.title: Document vector-only scope
options.body: Close the feature direction by documenting that default memory-core/QMD own hybrid retrieval while LanceDB remains a vector backend.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add a `memory-lancedb`-owned hybrid mode with FTS index setup, explicit config/defaults, query-text propagation, vector fallback, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main ownership signal for the central memory-lancedb source and prior maintainer-side review context on this issue.
